Angular Integration with

integrates with Angular through /angular. The package extends the core contract with Angular State Signals, application providers, class metadata, and typed dependency injection.

Angular package usage

can run in an Angular application without /angular. The core APIs remain available, but Angular-specific State Signals, providers, decorators, and injection APIs are supplied only by the Angular package.

Angular Integration

/angular is an Angular integration wrapper around the core APIs. It preserves the core contract and adds Angular-specific surfaces for Signals, application configuration, class registration, dependency injection, and lifecycle ownership.

State Signals

The Angular exposes its current State through read-only Signals for the resolved value, loading status, Error, and value presence. These Signals provide Angular-reactive access to the latest State Snapshot.

@FeatureCell

@FeatureCell marks an Angular class with a unique key and a compile-time State type. The decorator establishes identity and typing for Angular registration and injection.

Read the @FeatureCell documentation →

provideFeatureCell

provideFeatureCell registers an Angular service class with a configured . The resulting Angular provider exposes the core API together with Angular State Signals and lifecycle ownership.

injectVault

injectVault injects the typed associated with an @FeatureCell-decorated class. The injected surface includes State access, State replacement and merging, and configured Behavior Extensions.
